rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected for rotating into a front-facing read during the attack branch.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: one-shot strike; compatible with lingpet_companion_sprite_animator.gd 5x5 frame math

postprocess.tool: AutoSprite direct 256px sheet promotion with alpha QA
postprocess.note: The accepted rear-only candidate already matches Koyora idle/move cell scale, keeps whole-sheet edge alpha at zero, and places rear puppet-string strike poses in the runtime 18-24 frame window.

notes: Gameplay-scale preview matches existing Koyora idle and move body class at companion_strike_draw_size 92.0.
No visible rectangular glow, square aura, magenta key, or green key pixels remain in non-transparent sprite pixels.
